demos.title: App Initialization & inject
demos.teaches: Run startup logic before bootstrap with provideAppInitializer and read the loaded configuration from a service resolved with inject().

demos.title: Async App Initializer
demos.teaches: Await a lazily imported service during bootstrap by combining provideAppInitializer with injectAsync, and prefetch the same chunk on idle from a component.

demos.title: Service Decorator & Migration
demos.teaches: Replace @Injectable with the @Service decorator, scope a service to a single route with autoProvided:false, and run the 22.1 service-migration schematic.

demos.title: Error Handling
demos.teaches: Catch and transform HTTP failures in an interceptor, and route everything an interceptor misses through the global ErrorHandler token.

demos.title: HTTP Interceptors
demos.teaches: Chain multiple functional interceptors for auth headers, retries and error mapping in one provideHttpClient call.

demos.title: Navigation Errors
demos.teaches: Record and redirect failed navigations with withNavigationErrorHandler, and catch everything else in a custom ErrorHandler class.

demos.title: Component Input Bindings
demos.teaches: Bind route and query parameters straight into signal inputs with withComponentInputBinding, keeping component state and URL in sync without ActivatedRoute.

demos.title: Route Input Bindings
demos.teaches: Configure withComponentInputBinding with its options object, and see why paramsInheritanceStrategy defaulting to always makes child routes inherit parent parameters and data.

demos.title: Route Titles
demos.teaches: Set dynamic page titles for each route using the title property in route configuration. Update browser tab titles automatically.

demos.title: Route Resolvers with Signals
demos.teaches: Preload route data with an HTTP ResolveFn and receive it in a required signal input, type-safe and auto-unwrapped, with no subscription in the component.

demos.title: CanMatch Guard
demos.teaches: Use canMatch guards to conditionally load routes based on runtime conditions. Prevent route initialization before matching.

demos.title: Route Guards
demos.teaches: Stack multiple route guards to enforce authorization policies. Combine authentication and role-based access control.

demos.title: Preloading Strategy
demos.teaches: Implement custom preloading strategies to eager-load routes in the background. Optimize performance with selective preloading.

demos.title: Route Driven Signal Store
demos.teaches: Feed a route-scoped NgRx SignalStore from route params bound as signal inputs, so the URL is the only writer of the filter state.

demos.title: Router Animations
demos.teaches: Animate entering and leaving elements with animate.enter and animate.leave, and let withViewTransitions animate navigation, all without @angular/animations.

demos.title: Animate Enter and Leave
demos.teaches: Animate routed components in and out with animate.enter and animate.leave while withViewTransitions cross-fades the surrounding page.

demos.title: View Transitions
demos.teaches: Leverage native View Transitions API for seamless animated navigation. Create shared element animations across route changes.
